purpose: Teach: アキ/垂れ/行儀/ドーナツ/スナック/埃/味わえる/うんと

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさんの妹さん、本気で、絶対、アキさんって、絶対、優しい人だったよな、覚えてる?本気で、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, your grandmother's sister Aki was such a kind person. Do you remember? She really was.
lines.style: Soft opening, traveling back in memory. Gentle cadence on the names. Slight upward lilt on the question — checking if she remembers too. Warm, unhurried, as if holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。最近、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お口、絶対、垂れちゃうこと、増えたわよね、あなた、本気で、絶対、お互いに、年だしね。
lines.en: Yes. Lately you've been drooling more, haven't you dear? We're getting older, both of us.
lines.style: Tender teasing, without cruelty. Matter-of-fact observation wrapped in affection. Slight smile in the voice. The comfort of saying what needs saying to someone who won't take it wrong.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃の私たち、本気で、絶対、行儀、絶対、しっかり、絶対、しつけられたよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, we had such proper manners drilled into us, remember? Your grandmother was strict about that.
lines.style: Reflective, a little nostalgic. Light emphasis on 「行儀」— the old discipline settling into a smile. Pause before 「覚えてる」as if he's curious whether she'll connect to the same memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、ドーナツ、絶対、初めて、絶対、食べた日のこと、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、感動した、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: I remember the day you first ate a donut. Do you? I was so moved by how excited you were.
lines.style: Warm recollection breaking through. The words slow slightly on 「初めて」 — savoring the small moment in time. Soft wonder in the voice, like he's still a little amazed by her joy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、スナック、絶対、二人で、絶対、よく、絶対、シェアしたわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, we used to share snacks all the time, didn't we? Just the two of us.
lines.style: Gentle, almost private tone. The memory of small intimacy. Slight lift on 「よく」— emphasizing the easiness and frequency. Trailing warmth, like he's grateful it happened.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 家、本気で、絶対、埃、絶対、たまりやすくなってきたわよね、あなた、本気で、絶対、お互いに、絶対、お掃除、頑張らないとね、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The house collects dust so easily now, doesn't it? We're both going to have to try harder to keep up, dear.
lines.style: Practical observation softened by affection. Not complaining — just noticing. The slight weariness of shared aging in the rhythm, but accompanied by gentle determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、田舎の味、絶対、味わえる、絶対、時代、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、思い出深い、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, we could still taste the food from the countryside. Those were the days. Do you remember how it all felt?
lines.style: Distant and present at once. The words on 「田舎の味」linger — he's tasting it as he speaks. Slower pace. Quiet gratitude underneath. Question at the end feels like a gift, not a demand.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃の私たち、本気で、絶対、うんと、絶対、楽しい時間、絶対、過ごしたわよね、あなた
lines.en: When we were young, we spent so much time together and it was wonderful. Don't you think?
lines.style: Settled, satisfied exhale. The words 「楽しい時間」come with a small smile. No rush. This is the comfort of sitting together, holding the shared past without needing to embellish it. Warm close.
